name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Claude-4.6-Opus-Reasoning-Distilled
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 30 of 40 layers are linear_attention and 10 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes:
ADDED 2026-10-25. A distillation of Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 35.952 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-04-17.

EVIDENCE CAVEAT, the strongest kind. The single recorded row is a 70-question MMLU-Pro smoke run (`--limit 5` across 14 subjects), and the card says in its own words: 'Treat this as a smoke/comparative check, not a release-quality full benchmark.' A 42.86 vs 75.71 split on 70 questions is roughly a 30-question swing and says the fine-tune changed answer formatting/parsing as much as knowledge. It is recorded with the sample size in the benchmark name so it can never be averaged against a full-set MMLU-Pro row. The card's other large table is the upstream Qwen3.6 release table reproduced for reference and explicitly NOT a benchmark of this checkpoint, so none of it was taken. Treat this record as thin: it has one small-sample row.
